canonical_jtbd: When new customer data arrives from external sources (spreadsheets, emails, web forms), I want to automatically import and update CRM records without manual copy-paste, so I can reduce errors, avoid duplicates, and free up time for sales and service activities.
painful_workflow: Manually copying customer data from spreadsheets, emails, or other sources into CRM fields, often involving multiple steps (export, clean, import, deduplicate) and requiring intermediate staging in Excel.
current_workaround: Using Excel spreadsheets as an intermediate staging area for data cleaning before uploading to CRM, or hiring freelancers to manually copy-paste rows from CSV into CRM fields.
source_evidence: Manually entering and updating customer records in the CRM by copy-pasting from spreadsheets and other systems.
Data entry errors, duplicate records, and delayed sales follow-up due to time spent on manual tasks.
Manually copying customer data from email orders into a CRM and then re-entering the same data into invoicing software.
Data entry errors cause shipping mistakes, delayed invoices, and wasted 30–60 minutes per day.
Manual import of customer data from spreadsheets into CRM after each marketing campaign.
Delayed follow-up with leads, inconsistent data entry (missing fields, duplicates), customer frustration from late responses.
Exporting customer data from HubSpot into Excel, cleaning duplicates, then importing back after manual deduplication.
Non-compliance if emails sent to opt-out contacts; wasted 4–8 hours each month; staff dreads the process.

canonical_jtbd: When I need to ensure data consistency across CRM, billing, marketing, and support systems, I want to automatically reconcile records without manual comparison, so I can prevent errors, improve attribution, and save hours of manual work.
painful_workflow: Periodically exporting data from multiple systems (CRM, billing, marketing, support) into spreadsheets, manually matching line items, and identifying discrepancies using formulas like VLOOKUP.
current_workaround: Using Excel pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and manual cross-checking; hiring freelancers to compare reports line by line.
source_evidence: Reconciling CRM opportunity data with billing and invoicing systems by pulling data from both and manually matching line items in spreadsheets.
Revenue recognition errors, delays in financial reporting, and time-consuming audits due to missing traceability.
Exporting contact lists and engagement data from the CRM and importing them into email marketing tools, then reconciling the resulting campaign data back into the CRM.
Stale or inconsistent data across systems, poor lead attribution, and wasted hours that could be spent on high-impact marketing activities.
Manually reconciling customer interactions across email, chat, and support tickets to ensure nothing is missed.
Missed follow-ups, duplicate responses, poor customer experience, and up to 2 hours daily spent on reconciliation.
Weekly reconciliation of customer orders between Shopify and QuickBooks using manual cross-checking.
Payroll errors, inventory discrepancies, accounting adjustments taking hours, risk of audit flags.
ambiguity_reason: SIG-002 (Reddit) focuses on communication channel reconciliation, which may differ from financial data reconciliation but shares the same manual cross-system comparison pattern.

canonical_jtbd: When I need to respond to compliance requests or audits, I want to automatically generate accurate reports from CRM data, so I can avoid penalties, meet deadlines, and reduce manual effort.
painful_workflow: Manually querying CRM using SQL or custom reports, exporting to spreadsheets, formatting templates, and compiling PDFs with screenshots.
current_workaround: Using custom SQL queries, Excel templates, and hiring freelancers to compile reports.
source_evidence: Generating compliance reports (e.g., GDPR access requests, audit logs) by manually querying the CRM and exporting data to spreadsheets for formatting and review.
Slow response times to legal requests, risk of missing data, and non-compliance penalties.
Manual generation of customer KYC reports for financial audits using Excel pivot tables and copy-paste from multiple systems.
Non-compliance fines, missed reporting deadlines, inconsistent data quality, high cost of freelance labor each month.

canonical_jtbd: When our CRM lacks required features or stable integrations, I want to build or use reliable integrations without custom scripts, so I can reduce technical debt, maintenance costs, and system breakage.
painful_workflow: Developing custom scripts, using unofficial APIs, or hiring consultants to bridge gaps between systems, with constant maintenance when APIs change.
current_workaround: Custom scripts, hiring freelancers with SQL skills, manual verification.
source_evidence: Building and maintaining internal scripts or third-party workarounds to compensate for missing CRM customizations and integrations.
High technical debt, costly maintenance, and constant breakage when systems update their APIs.
Manual migration of customer data from legacy CRM (Zoho) to Salesforce requiring field mapping and deduplication.
Data loss, corrupt records, duplicate contacts, weeks of delays, customer service disruption during migration.
